BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses rôwmâh for elation, that is (adverbially) proudly. It stands in Micah 2:3: "Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, against this…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rôwmâh is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
